name: TandemLLM
description: Serve Qwen3.8-27B on a single DGX Spark with speculative decoding, conversation caches, and a local dashboard.
compatibility: OpenAI-compatible model API with tool calls and structured output; documented opencode connection.
limitations: Currently qualified for one DGX Spark and Qwen3.8-27B; other CUDA GPUs are best effort.
Requires the documented Python 3.11, PyTorch/CUDA, and Triton stack; run one engine per board.
Code is AGPL-3.0-only with a separate commercial option; documentation and model artifacts have separate licenses.

sources.note: Documents the listed workflow, requirements, compatibility, and limitations.
